description: A locked field an invariant reads, given a call of a `fn` of compile-time constants that reads nothing live (`<w b=(dbl(2))/>`, `dbl` reads only its argument): accepted (the value tracks nothing; the construction check holds it).
rationale: Ruling S483-invariant-derived-split: "a field that tracks a cell or a live use-site value stays refused, PERMANENT, E-CONTRACT-003" — a call of constants that reads nothing live, at any depth, tracks nothing.
